name: FreeAddMonoid.countP_of
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
p : α → Prop
inst✝ : DecidablePred p
x : α
⊢ Eq ((FreeAddMonoid.countP p) (FreeAddMonoid.of x)) (ite (Eq (p x) (Eq Bool.true Bool.true)) 1 0)
decl:
theorem countP_of (x : α) : countP p (of x) = if p x = true then 1 else 0 := by
  change List.countP p [x] = _
  simp [List.countP_cons]

name: FreeAddMonoid.countP_apply
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
p : α → Prop
inst✝ : DecidablePred p
l : FreeAddMonoid α
⊢ Eq ((FreeAddMonoid.countP p) l) (List.countP (fun b => Decidable.decide (p b)) l)
decl: theorem countP_apply (l : FreeAddMonoid α) : countP p l = List.countP p l := rfl

name: FreeAddMonoid.count_of
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
inst✝ : DecidableEq α
x y : α
⊢ Eq ((FreeAddMonoid.count x) (FreeAddMonoid.of y)) (Pi.single x 1 y)
decl:
theorem count_of [DecidableEq α] (x y : α) : count x (of y) = (Pi.single x 1 : α → ℕ) y := by
  change List.count x [y] = _
  simp [Pi.single, Function.update, List.count_cons]

name: FreeMonoid.countP_of'

α : Type u_1
p : α → Prop
inst✝ : DecidablePred p
x : α
⊢ Eq ((FreeMonoid.countP p) (FreeMonoid.of x)) (ite (p x) (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) (Multiplicative.ofAdd 0))

theorem countP_of' (x : α) :
    countP p (of x) = if p x then Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 else Multiplicative.ofAdd 0 := by
    erw [FreeAddMonoid.countP_of]
    simp only [eq_iff_iff, iff_true, ofAdd_zero]; rfl

name: FreeMonoid.countP_of
initialProofState:

⊢ Eq ((FreeMonoid.countP p) (FreeMonoid.of x)) (ite (p x) (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) 1)

theorem countP_of (x : α) : countP p (of x) = if p x then Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 else 1 := by

name: FreeMonoid.count_of
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
inst✝ : DecidableEq α
x y : α
⊢ Eq ((FreeMonoid.count x) (FreeMonoid.of y)) (Pi.mulSingle x (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) y)
decl:
theorem count_of [DecidableEq α] (x y : α) :
    count x (of y) = @Pi.mulSingle α (fun _ => Multiplicative ℕ) _ _ x (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) y :=
  by simp [count, countP_of, Pi.mulSingle_apply, eq_comm, Bool.beq_eq_decide_eq]
